comment: Captured terminal output shown on the landing page. Not generated: re-capture when the CLI output changes. Lines are wrapped to 80 columns; omitted fields are marked with ... and named in the caption.
caption: A request to the running server and its real reply, captured 2026-10-28 on the benchmark machine (commit ac35bd9, the build in the benchmark run). The id, reasoning_content and usage fields are cut; the reply stops at max_tokens=40.

steps.cmd:
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8203/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.strim/token)" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"qwen38-4bit","max_tokens":40,"messages":[
    {"role":"user","content":"Reply with one short sentence about Swift."}]}'
